skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the fundamental theories of international trade, including classical and modern models, and apply them to analyze real-world scenarios.
Analyze and interpret international trade policies and their impacts on global trade.
Manage and optimize international trade operations, including tariff and non-tariff barriers.
Understand and evaluate the effects of economic integration on international trade.
Conduct independent research and analyze data related to international trade issues.
Work effectively in teams to solve complex international trade problems.
Prepare and deliver effective presentations on international trade topics.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate and solve international trade issues.
Demonstrate the ability to self-learn and stay updated with international trade developments.
Understand the global economic environment and its impact on international trade.
